component.name: Uma Mod Manager
component.summary: Manage, inspect, configure, and create Umamusume mods

description.p: Uma Mod Manager is a cross-platform mod manager and mod-development workspace for Umamusume Pretty Derby, forked from UMML / UmaMusume Mod Loader.
Players can browse and import mods, use named profiles, configure package variants, inspect conflicts, and apply or restore verified transactional deployments.

Creators can inspect source bundles and final targets, describe affected characters, dresses, parts, and content types, edit compatibility policy, build configurable packages, and test new immutable versions.
Compatible imports prepare and analyze automatically. Manual Prepare or Re-prepare maintenance is not part of the user workflow.
Settings can generate a privacy-scrubbed support bundle for structured testing and bug reports without including game assets, mod payloads, baselines, roster snapshots, or raw settings.

The guarded compatibility Studio preserves original UMML editing tools while native Manager workflows replace them. Read-only veteran-data tools can install user-supplied extractor source packages and run supported Werseter source through the bundled Python 3.14 host without redistributing unlicensed scanner code.

Publishes the audited responsive UI and Veteran Roster, readable aptitude and evaluation ranks, corrected factor and skill metadata, importer hardening, GameBanana download-count hydration, and a browser-assisted fallback for GameBanana files that return browser-only HTML.

Adds a standalone packaged Python 3.14 host for supported user-supplied Werseter source ZIPs, bundles minidump 0.0.24, verifies the host with an executable fixture, improves interpreter fallback detection, and upgrades older managed source installations automatically.

Adds managed installation of recognized Werseter source ZIPs, automatic Discover loading, resilient GameBanana retries and Core API fallback, bounded provider caches, safer failed downloads, preparation recovery, and clearer UI state.

Adds the Community Test release track, exact release metadata auditing, structured tester guidance and feedback forms, privacy-scrubbed support bundles, repeatable prerelease packaging, and stronger documentation and package-content checks.

Establishes the Uma Mod Manager identity, removes manual preparation controls, supports multi-target source bundles, adds visual Inspect and edit workflows, improves focused windows and Library actions, and expands credited veteran-data provider compatibility.
Adds package targeting, character and dress metadata, semantic profile options, compatibility editing, relative load-order rules, and native package editing.
Adds profile-scoped configurable packages, source-to-target option mapping, guided creator workspaces, and the comparative manager design review.
Connects all Manager entry points to robust installation discovery, adds persistent themes, and fixes packaged Linux folder opening.
Initial separately packaged Manager foundation with an immutable library, profiles, conflict planning, verified deployment, baselines, providers, GUI, CLI, tests, and Debian packaging.
